notes: All rows measured on ONE RunPod RTX 5090 32GB (community, driver 620, torch 2.8 cu128) unless measured:false.
End-to-end per frame: uint8 384x384 host frame -> H2D -> encode -> UNet (1 step, t=999) -> decode -> uint8 D2H; batch 1, median of 60 after 15 warmup.

turbo_lora+TAESD rows: TAESD encoder/decoder swapped in for the skip-connected SD-VAE with the SAME turbo_lora UNet; latency of the architecture only. That checkpoint was trained with the SD-VAE + skips, so TAESD output quality is NOT valid until TAESD (or its decoder) is fine-tuned with the LoRA.
fp16 without compile is launch-overhead bound (fp16 at 256 is no faster than fp32); torch.compile gives the big win.
Not measured: TensorRT, CUDA graphs, int8, other GPUs. Estimate for an RTX 4090: ~1.3-1.6x the 5090 times (not measured).
